summary.text: Kerry Gruenhagen is a Republican Iowa state senator who has represented District 41 since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
His career experience includes owning a business and farming.

paragraphs.text: Kerry Gruenhagen's career experience includes owning a business and working as a farmer, and he has been affiliated with the Muscatine County Farm Bureau.
He assumed office in the Iowa State Senate on January 3, 2023, and advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
